summary.text: Mike Johnson is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 27 (Rapides Parish), and was elected in 2019, according to the official House member page.
The House lists Michael T. Johnson as Speaker Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Mike Johnson's occupation as Attorney.
It lists education as Pineville High School, 1977; B.A., Public Administration, Louisiana College, 1981; J.D., Southern University Law Center, 1984.

The page lists committee assignments including Civil Law and Procedure and House and Governmental Affairs, along with ex officio seats on other committees, and caucus affiliations including the Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
